title: Reset button Beta testing
script:
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
local ResetButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

ScreenGui.Parent = game.CoreGui
ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

ResetButton.Name = "ResetButton"
ResetButton.Parent = ScreenGui
ResetButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
ResetButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -75, 0.9, -25)
ResetButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 50)
ResetButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
ResetButton.Text = "Reset Character"
ResetButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ResetButton.TextSize = 14.000

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.V then
        UserInputService.MouseBehavior = 
            UserInputService.MouseBehavior == Enum.MouseBehavior.Default 
            and Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter 
            or Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
    end
end)

ResetButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local character = player.Character
    if character then
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.Health = 0
        end
        task.wait(0.1)
        player:LoadCharacter()
    end
end)

comments.text: Thank you for making this script. I was stuck and could not reset no matter what I tried. It was frustrating, but now, with your script, I can finally reset. It took me 18 years just to reset, thank you for making this script.
